title: Beau Lamarre-Condon sized up surfboard bag against friend before allegedly murdering Sydney couple, court told
summary_full: Former NSW police officer has pleaded not guilty to murdering Jesse Baird and Luke Davies before concealing bodies in bags bought from sports storeFollow our Australia news live blog for latest updatesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastBeau Lamarre-Condon was seen sizing up a surfboard bag used to dispose of a victim days before the police officer murdered two men, prosectors have alleged in a Sydney court, with chilling CCTV footage shown to the jury.Months earlier, the 31-year-old had asked a friend over a video call to help him obtain something, and then formed a gun gesture with his hand, the NSW supreme court trial heard on Thursday.
